entries.status: UNIQUE under the lift rule - RAW 70% RULE FALSIFIED (IR-67-GATE-02)
entries.summary: 0.9992 of the dots lie within 3 px of gems61-lane-buried-step-gravinversion-hgm-r3-k400k-b2zeros.tif, but that raster's own 3 px dilation covers 95.8% of the footprint and 96.0% of the eligible band, so the matched lift is 1.04 and the statistic carries no lane-copying information. Max |rho| 0.286; max lift 1.378 < 1.5. The raw rule in the pre-registered P4 is therefore falsified and disclosed rather than waived.

entries.status: GATE UNEVALUABLE - negative control degenerate by construction (IR-67-INSTR-01/-02)
entries.summary: Pooled holdout DTI is exactly 0.0 [0.0, 0.0] because the 400 m exclusion removes every dot inside the credit radius of a truth layer that is the exclusion's own complement. The only truth layer is range-front-confined and anti-correlated with the owner-reported outcome (catalogue -0.554, SGMC-all -0.872). No gain is claimed; the pre-registered P3 failed.

T31A-2838 is real: 'Mapping of normal fault scarps in airborne laser swath mapping data using wavelet analysis', Sare & Hilley, AGU FM15, session T31A, 16 Dec 2015 - it presents wavelet templates with initial scarp slope and above/below-scarp angles and analyses Surprise Valley and Jenny Lake sites. Steger verified as TPAMI 20(2):113-125, 1998, doi:10.1109/34.659930. Nuance: the checkout's template family is the scarplet package (JOSS doi:10.21105/joss.01066), not the wavelet code itself (IR-67-SRC-01).
